_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With momentum hot but macro fear hotter, the market is coiling within Hope's 63-70 band digesting whether this is a blow-off top or consolidation, and without a VIX break below 14 or funding reset there is no base rate to justify a directional call.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst calls HOLD with low conviction citing macro divergence; narrative implies constructive continuation with higher confidence, so the split favors the analyst's caution
next_move.confirmed_if: VIX breaks below 14 and funding resets above 0.015% with ETF flows >85
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX spikes above 20 with BTC losing 200W MA support and funding turning negative
